description: This header file declares an API for managing temporary object directories within a Git repository context. It provides functions for creating, migrating, destroying, and manipulating temporary object directories, as well as integrating them as alternates in the object database.
external_files: standard C headers for memory and string management

methods.name: tmp_objdir_create
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory with a specified prefix associated with a repository.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_env
methods.description: Returns environment variables to enable subprocesses to use the temporary object directory.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_migrate
methods.description: Migrates the temporary object's contents into the main object database and cleans up.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the temporary object directory without migrating its objects.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_discard_objects
methods.description: Removes all objects within the temporary object directory, leaving the directory intact for further use.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate
methods.description: Adds the temporary object directory as an alternate object store to the current process.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the temporary one, optionally destroying it.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Restores the original primary object database if it was replaced.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database, possibly changing its path.
